author: gurukamath
content:
🧪  `bogota-devnet@v1.1.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-bogota-devnet@v1.1.0

We are using this EELS branch for reference: [`devnets/bogota/1`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/bogota/1) (renamed from `devnets/frames/1`)

PTAL at the release notes & the test [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3727) for the full scope.
Consensus-breaking since v1.0.0: EIP-8250 now prices nonce keys, hence the minor bump. Genesis is unchanged. Thanks Ivan (EIP-8250 pricing, EIP-8141 rollback tests), Felipe (EIP-8141 approval edge cases) and Justin & lightclient (Besu and geth mappings)!

**New in v1.1.0:**
- EIP-8250 ⚠️ each non-zero nonce key costs `COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS + STORAGE_WRITE` (12,100 gas) in intrinsic gas and the calldata floor, and the consumed keys appear in the block access list as `NONCE_MANAGER` storage changes [EIPs#12457](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12457).
- EIP-8141: approval context rollback on a reverted call is now pinned by tests, validation prefix and execution body defined in the EIP, plus new `APPROVE` edge-case coverage [EIPs#12458](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12458), [EIPs#12471](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12471).
- EIP-7906: `TXTRACE`/`TXDIFF` params named and block access list recording for `TXDIFF` and the `POST_TX` rollback specified, no implementation change [EIPs#12468](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12468), [EIPs#12463](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12463).
- EIP-8272: unchanged.
- Client mappings for geth, Besu and ethrex frame/keyed-nonce rejections.

Thanks <@755913785620824175> <@796570016966770688> <@281967554572976128>
